name: Untold Darkness: The Curse
source:
Alex is back! Wanna know what perils are awaiting you this time?
Mysterious disappearances of students, Alex being on the verge of death…
Will you ever be able to bring back peaceful days to Rossadeavel University?!
All this and more our wait for you in our newest “Untold Darkness” book!

[From official site]
translation:
亚历克斯回来了！想知道这次有什么危险在等着你吗？
学生神秘失踪，亚历克斯濒临死亡……
你能否让Rossadeavel大学恢复平静的日子？！
所有这些以及更多内容，我们在最新的《不为人知的黑暗》一书中等待着你！

[来自官方网站]
